notes.title: Brand New Content Update: LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/19a36d5cfb68dbab8f81489518d4d0dc54fd976e.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that Die After Sunset has just received a brand-new update today on Steam! 🚀✨ Get ready for all-new changes including: 

🎯 New Shooting Mechanics 
💃 New Player Animations
🎓 New Tutorial Level 
🎥 Boss Cutscenes Added
📊 New HUD 
🏹 New Missions 
🐞 Bug Fixes & Balancing 
🌟 And More!

We've been working on this update for a while now & would like to thank everyone who helped beta test and tweak these latest changes. Keep your eyes peeled for more in the future! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ef8f892476fbc867bfdcd1d4151e70112560ef00.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/58eb7604ed4a9951e906a4c043d189a8758c9fe8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/eb085934dc0a40e57a735725aad6fe70447e2701.gif[/img]

There are 3 large boxes of dynamite, all connected to very long lines of rope. These are being lit up by the Murkers and your job is to protect the area to make sure they don't reignite it. 

Although it is only 1 minute, they will swarm the area and you must make sure to not get carried away removing the Murkers. they might of lit up one of the detonating cords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/6d5dc4ee247e17680f00acc0818e6a4544b9c675.gif[/img]

After 1 minute much like every other mission, you are rewarded depending on how many boxes of dynamite has been detonated. A simple yet a cluster of fun to be had with this mission and another mission in the our pool of RNG missions to keep your gameplay fresh.

[h3]Die After Sunset is 25% off today as part of the new update, buy now and experience it for yourself![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/Die_After_Sunset/

notes.title: 1.0 Release is coming! New Trailer Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/62f333c51a0d069600cfd40e0cdf983c9bfa2356.png[/img]

Get ready to blast into an action-packed adventure through time with Die After Sunset! The full 1.0 release is coming out later this year, and we have just released a brand new trailer to get you even more excited!

[previewyoutube=oZ_MafHxIbA;full][/previewyoutube]
Since we launch in Early Access last year, we've been working on lots of changes, gearing up for the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/95135dd94f64eab8c0d62299a372fa2b26282cb1.gif[/img]

In Die After Sunset, Earth is under attack by aliens known as the 'Murkors', and it's up to you to lead the resistance against them. With three unique play styles to choose from, including sharp-shooter 'April', machine-gun spraying cyborg 'Rido', and the finger-lazor zapping 'Hune', you'll be able to take on these invaders in a way that suits you best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ef8f892476fbc867bfdcd1d4151e70112560ef00.gif[/img]

Travel through time and save the world across five gigantic levels, each set in a different era, and fight off never-ending waves of Murkors in a sun-lit shooting frenzy. But beware, when the Murkors enter the shadows, they become stronger and scarier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/d18be98663cf88f239a5a0222efe4c6d3704cd10.gif[/img]

Each run in Die After Sunset is unique, with 19 in-game missions that are randomly populated every time you start a new run. Experiment with hundreds of item combinations to discover new ways to power up and become stronger than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/88d9eb383e322779ec59ea9152edbad2ba800839.gif[/img]

And if you fall in battle, don't worry, death is only the beginning! Return to the fight, levelled-up and stronger with each new run! Use in-game currency, "Mukus", to power up your stats, grab new items, and unlock even more weapons and powers by completing challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/2b750e3d8d3d1397a13a92c10eba523bc962085a.gif[/img]

Die After Sunset is a vibrant roguelite shooter that offers never-ending target practice and adrenaline-fueled shooting frenzy. The full 1.0 release is coming out later this year, so keep an eye out for it on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/Die_After_Sunset/

notes.title: Content Update #1: OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ca3d85533c2be4efd0a086a4ed9ed8bdde1567c2.png[/img]

Hey Everyone!

[b]We are pleased to release the first of the big Early Access updates to rogue-lite shooter Die After Sunset![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/d7b40b7a24f52e68e46f1ff2261cfa8f4d34421f.gif[/img]

[b]This brand new content update features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Brand new level[/b]  - Visit the icy village of Yggdrasil and aid their fight against the Murkor threat.

[*] [b]New Items[/b] - Tool up with brand new items like the 'Pocket Shield' and 'Fire Drone'!

[*] [b]New Boss[/b] - Something evil lurks at the heart of the village... Be careful once sunset comes around...

[*] [b]Bug Fixes & Game Balancing [/b]- Huge amount of bug fixes, game balancing and unlocks; with submachine-gunning cyborg 'Rido' available to play straight away! 
[/list]

[b][i]More to come! Multiple updates adding everything from co-op gameplay to brand new characters and levels are all planned for the coming months. [/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/6b0609050673c9e279c116e8a18cd9ca7b59d9ab.gif[/img]

[b]Some New Tools To Play With![/b]
[i]Have a look at what new items are included in the new update![/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Self-Destruction: [/b]Blow your shield up and let nearby enemies feel the blast
[*][b] Pocket Shield: [/b]A good defensive item that fits in the palm of your hand
[*] [b]Auto-aimed Gift:[/b] Every hit landed has the chance to trigger a free missile shot
[*] [b]Dark Ritual:[/b] Murkors take more damage when they are in the shadows
[*] [b]Book of Resistance:[/b] Increases your resistance to damage
[*] [b]Fire Drone: [/b]A drone that sets fire to everything in sight
[*] [b]Ice Drone: [/b]A drone that freezes all its targets
[*] [b]Shock Drone: [/b]A drone that leaves your enemies profoundly shocked
[*] [b]Poison Drone:[/b] A drone that poisons everything it hits
[/list]

[b]See the brand new content update #1 trailer here:[/b]

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

Quick playtest patch incoming. Here's the changes:

-Fixed the boss battle sometimes not ending
-Fix video settings bug with VSync
-Fix boss event fail not being displayed
-Fix Generator event, button activation
-Fix player control loss while using special roll
-Murkors now have a delay before the 1st attack
-Fix permanent invulnerable effect
-Charging April's charged shot now stops sprinting
-Fix decoy targeting bug in The Murkraken boss

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've been blown away by the amount of people who've joined our free playtest - so firstly, thank you all! We have seen some feedback around some issues and features in-game, so have rolled out a quick mid-test patch for you, which hopefully rectifies some things. We want to thank you for your patience so far. We are still in the development phase of the game and have some issues to iron out, so appreciate all the feedback we have received so far. Here are the changes:

[list]
    [*]New options to deactivate some visual effects, including motion blur
    [*]Murkraken boss countdown bug fixed, event now fails on time out
    [*]Added SFX to more items
    [*]Improve performance at beginning of events
    [*]Add post-process effects options in video settings
    [*]Add weapon element in HUD
    [*]Fixed some minor event bugs
    [*]Testing new balancing around Murkow spawn behaviour
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/23d7b4ab5913538f54bbb4d7d467e175266c3d8f.png[/img]

If you'd like to give us some feedback or join the rest of the gang, hit up our Discord.
